name: glm-academic
description: Academic research plugin bundling six skills: aminer-academic-search (full AMiner access with 28 APIs for scholar profiles, paper deep dives, semantic search, institution analysis, venue monitoring and patent details), aminer-daily-paper (personalized paper digest via the AMiner rec5 API), aminer-deep-search (multi-round deep literature collection for surveys), aminer-free-academic (zero-cost lookups through seven free AMiner APIs), glm-literature-survey (6-20 page PDF surveys with 60+ real citations) and glm-research-explorer (turning fuzzy research directions into concrete topics). Trigger for literature retrieval, survey writing, paper recommendation and topic selection. The four AMiner skills require AMINER_API_KEY.

interface.shortDescription: Six academic skills: AMiner search/digest/deep-collection/free lookups, literature surveys and research topic exploration.
interface.longDescription: GLM Academic bundles the complete academic research stack for locally deployed Codex agents. Four AMiner skills cover the full API spectrum: aminer-academic-search (28 paid APIs for scholar profiles, paper deep dives, semantic search, institution and patent analysis), aminer-free-academic (7 free APIs for lightweight lookups and routing), aminer-daily-paper (rec5 personalized digests) and aminer-deep-search (host-model-driven multi-round survey collection). glm-literature-survey renders 6-20 page PDF surveys with 60+ real citations; glm-research-explorer turns fuzzy directions into concrete topics. The four AMiner skills share one routing ladder and require AMINER_API_KEY; all scripts are pure standard-library with no SDK.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-academic plugin skills: <检索学术文献 / 论文日报 / 综述收集 / 文献综述 PDF / 研究选题>
